title: CAISO: batteries and the evening peak
subtitle: Mean by hour of the day, 2026-09-03 to 2026-10-02; battery output below zero is charging

facts: CAISO, 2026-09-03 to 2026-10-02: mean demand peaked in the hour starting 17:00 Pacific at 35203.2 MW, when batteries delivered a mean 1585.15 MW; batteries delivered the most in the hour starting 19:00, 8442.57 MW, and charged hardest in the hour starting 11:00, -8268.63 MW.
Mean battery output 17:00 to 21:00 Pacific, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03: 6448.79 MW.
